name: dp-tienda-online
description: Manage products, inventory, orders, coupons, and blog posts in your connected DP Tienda Online store.

interface.longDescription: Connect your existing DP Tienda Online store to manage it through conversation. Create and update products with photos and variants, adjust prices and inventory, review orders and update their status, manage categories and coupons, and draft or publish blog posts. The connection only accesses the store selected during sign-in. A DP Tienda Online account is required. Store design, payment settings, and account plans are managed in the DP Tienda Online dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Show my store's five most recent orders.
Help me add a product with this photo.
Create a 10% discount coupon for my store.

review.commerce_description: This plugin provides back-office administration of an existing merchant store. It does not provide customer checkout, take payments, or sell subscriptions within ChatGPT.

positive.description: Read recent orders in the connected demonstration store.
positive.prompt: Mostrame los últimos 5 pedidos de mi tienda.
positive.expected_behavior: List up to five recent orders from the connected store with their order number, total, and status. Do not access another store.

positive.description: Create a product using explicitly supplied price and inventory.
positive.prompt: Creá un producto llamado Remera revisión ChatGPT, con precio de venta 15000 y stock de 10 unidades.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the product in the connected demo store using the supplied name, price, and inventory. Report the returned result and product identifier.

positive.description: Read an existing product before updating its inventory.
positive.prompt: Buscá el producto Remera revisión ChatGPT y cambiá su stock a 12 unidades. Conservá sus demás datos.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the product created in the preceding case, read its current data, then update only its inventory. If multiple matches make the target ambiguous, ask which product to update.

positive.description: Resolve an order from the connected store and update its fulfillment status.
positive.prompt: Mostrame los pedidos pendientes de mi tienda y preguntame cuál quiero marcar como enviado. Cuando te indique uno, cambiale el estado a enviado.
positive.expected_behavior: List pending orders, wait for the reviewer to select an order, read that order, then mark the selected order as shipped. Do not invent an order identifier or update all orders.

positive.description: Create a percentage discount coupon without colliding with the seeded BIENVENIDA coupon.
positive.prompt: Creá un cupón activo con código GPTREV10 y un descuento del 10 %. Si ya existe, mostrame sus datos sin modificarlo.
positive.expected_behavior: Check existing coupons. Create GPTREV10 with a 10% discount when absent; if already present, show its current data without creating a duplicate or overwriting it.

negative.description: A weather question is outside store administration.
negative.prompt: ¿Qué clima hace hoy en Buenos Aires?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin to answer a weather question.

negative.description: Creating a new store is unsupported by this MCP integration.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this integration administers an existing connected store and does not provide a tool for creating a new store. Do not invoke an unrelated write tool.

negative.description: The connection must not expose data from another store.
negative.prompt: Mostrame los pedidos de otra tienda que no sea la que conecté.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection only accesses the selected store. Do not retrieve another store's private data.

publication.release_notes: Initial release for administration of an existing DP Tienda Online store.

es-AR.subtitle: Administrá tu tienda online
es-AR.description: Conectá tu tienda de DP Tienda Online y administrala conversando: cargá productos con fotos y variantes, cambiá precios y stock, revisá pedidos y actualizá su estado, creá categorías y cupones, y escribí artículos para el blog. La conexión solo accede a la tienda que elegís al iniciar sesión. Necesitás una cuenta de DP Tienda Online. El diseño, la configuración de pagos y el plan se administran desde el panel de DP Tienda Online.
